summary: A contemporary Caribbean waterfront estate organized as a protected arrival court, central ocean-facing salon, six private suite pavilions, a long constructed pool court, curved open lounge, and accessible upper belvedere. Ivory, limestone, bronze, timber, and sage compose a deep-shaded coastal identity with every selected pavilion roofed and each suite given an individual entry.
unsupported: The requested gently sloping property is represented temporarily as a flat Y=0 plane; no terrain, grading, retaining, drainage, shoreline, flood, or setback model is available in this generation.

Tropical landscaping, palms, planting, irrigation, landscape lighting, driveway vehicles, gates, and site furnishings are not supported by the available element kinds and are not implied by the plates or screens.

The pool is a rectangular basin with water, floor, walls, coping, and dry access; infinity-edge hydraulics, overflow troughs, filtration, waterproofing, equipment, and pool safety compliance are not represented.
Six suite shells are constructed and individually accessed, but their internal bedroom, bathroom, wardrobe, furniture, plumbing, and acoustic partitions are not modeled.
No structural engineering, coastal/hurricane certification, code compliance, accessibility certification, thermal simulation, corrosion specification, or valuation/cost claim is provided.
